methods.what: Reduction of observed zenith distances of Fomalhaut by adding a refraction correction to the observed value
Reduction of Juno meridian observations: observed value corrected for thermometer (Th. F) and for instrument flexure (Biegg), giving corrected values and declinations
Declination expressed in terms of the latitude (correction dφ) and an instrumental constant correction dc
